## What's Changed

### Features

- **background-task**: cancel native ses_ via interrupt; revive via re-prompt
- **background-task**: cancel native ses_ via interrupt

### Bug Fixes

- **background**: relink native ses_ to bg_ handles, gate completion on deliverable output
- **context-mode**: fail-open detection via config and discipline presence
- **doctor**: accept V1 and V2 context-mode keys with migration hint
- **delegation**: ses auto-resolve via disk handle plus task code-mode fail-closed guard
- **background-task**: return tail messages in background_output foreign and full-session paths
- **tests**: sync toast cleanup robust to mock.module cell-patch leaks
- **tests**: task-system gating warning robust to mock.module pollution

### Refactoring

- **agents**: migrate context-mode prompts to V2 tool names
- **context-mode**: migrate constants and routing to V2 tool names

### Documentation

- **subagent-block**: truthful message and allowlist docs

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #59 from klpanagi/fix/bg-native-relink
- Merge pull request #58 from klpanagi/feature/context-mode-v2-migration
- Merge pull request #57 from klpanagi/feature/native-session-manageability
- Merge pull request #56 from klpanagi/fix/delegation-ses-resolve-codemode-guard
- Merge pull request #51 from klpanagi/fix/test-cleanup-36-failures
- Merge pull request #50 from klpanagi/chore/bump-bun-1-4-4

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0
